page_title: GET 1-1 RSO | Getafe v Real Sociedad 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+2' The foul by Yassin Tallal (Getafe) was seen by Victor Garcia who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
90+1' Jose Bordalas Jimenez is forced to make a change. Djene is unable to continue due to injury, Jordi Martin (Getafe) comes on.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Djene (Getafe) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
89' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Jaime Mata (Getafe) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
88' The substitution is prepared. Yassin Tallal (Getafe) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Oscar Rodriguez.
88' We are about to witness a substitution. Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) is replacing Jose Angel Carmona.
86' Jaime Mata (Getafe) takes a sweet touch after collecting a precise cross, and he produces a decent effort which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
84' Robin Le Normand is being substituted because of an injury. Imanol Alguacil sends Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) on the pitch.
82' The game is interrupted now, Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post.
81' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) will take a corner kick.

80' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the crossbar, but David Soria easily deals with the threat. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

78' Takefusa Kubo plays a pass to Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.

76' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Victor Garcia with no other option than to blow for a foul.
75' Jaime Mata (Getafe) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
74' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
74' The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
71' Jaime Mata (Getafe) picks up a rebound and attempts to send the ball in. The opponent's goalkeeper is rock steady and makes a great save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
70' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
69' Substitution. Aritz Elustondo (Real Sociedad) has come on for Arsen Zakharyan.
68' The game has come to an end for Sheraldo Becker. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad).
68' One of the players from Getafe times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) replacing Yellu Santiago.
67' Substitution. Jaime Mata (Getafe) replaces Juanmi Latasa.
66' A player from Real Sociedad brings down an opponent and commits a foul. Getafe get a free kick.
65' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) makes a rough challenge and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
63' The attendance is 12228.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
59' Half-chance! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) plays a pass into the box, but David Soria reacts well to snuff out the attack.
58' A pass by Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
55' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) produces a decent strike goalwards from the resulting set piece. His effort rattles the right post and the ball stays out of the net. The goalkeeper was quite lucky!
54' Getafe are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
50' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
48' Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) commits a rough foul. Victor Garcia stops the game and makes a call.
46' Imanol Alguacil decides to make a substitution. Ander Barrenetxea will be replaced by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
46' It's time for a substitution. Alvaro Odriozola (Real Sociedad) comes on in place of Hamari Traore.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.

45+3' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by David Soria.
45+2' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Victor Garcia interrupts the game. One of the players from Real Sociedad won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Getafe have been awarded a free kick.
40' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
39' Yellow card. Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
38' Dangerous play by Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad). Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
31' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
31' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' 1 - 1 Goal! Mason Greenwood picks out Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) with a perfect cross, and he has no problem to nod the ball into an empty net. It's 1:1.
29' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom left corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
28' Omar Alderete (Getafe) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is behind the touchline and Real Sociedad will take a throw-in.
26' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
24' Victor Garcia blows his whistle as Javi Galan (Real Sociedad) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
23' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
19' Yellu Santiago (Getafe) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Real Sociedad.
17' A pass by Luis Milla (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Sheraldo Becker produces a brilliant lofted pass and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
10' Djene (Getafe) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle. Real Sociedad win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
8' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and Getafe will have a goal kick.
7' Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
4' Djene (Getafe) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
3' Djene (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
2' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Getafe will kick-off.
Victor Garcia will supervise the game today.
